# Accessibility improvement

Please read [ACCESSIBILITY.md](https://github.com/zeruxjs/zeruxjs/blob/master/ACCESSIBILITY.md) before submitting. You do not need to know a standards reference to describe an accessibility improvement.

## Barrier or opportunity

<!-- Describe the user task and the barrier in plain language, not just a rule number. -->

## Reproduction and verification

<!-- Show how reviewers can reproduce and verify the task, including expected keyboard actions or output. -->

**Environment and tools used (only if tested):**

<!-- Browser/OS/assistive technology and versions; never claim a combination was tested if it was not. -->

**Checks actually completed:**

- [ ] Keyboard operation without a mouse
- [ ] Visible focus and logical focus order
- [ ] Accessible names, labels, instructions, and error messages
- [ ] Screen-reader experience (name the software/version in notes)
- [ ] Zoom, responsive layout, or text resizing
- [ ] Contrast, non-color cues, and reduced-motion support
- [ ] Documentation structure and text alternatives
- [ ] CLI/editor output with alternative input or noninteractive modes
- [ ] Automated check, if available (name tool and findings)

**Not tested / not applicable and why:**
